newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani money market rates close high.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani money market rates close high.

text.p: Pakistani money market rates wavered between 16.90 and 17 percent before closing at 17 percent due to a shortage of funds on Monday, dealers said.

With treasury bills worth 14.01 billion rupees maturing on Thursday, the central bank has announced a Short Term Federal Bonds auction for Tuesday, setting a pre-auction target at 16.51 billion rupees, a dealer at KASB & Company said.
"An open market operation maturity of 1.4 billion rupees is due on Tuesday but its effect could be negated, depending on the amounts discounted on Monday," he said.
